notes: Access: www.marshalls.com is Akamai-protected; reached via curl_cffi impersonating iOS Safari (safari18_0_ios), which serves m.marshalls.com and declares the canonical www.marshalls.com URL used in 'link'. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (checked). Marshalls' entire Pet assortment is a single flat department node 'Pet' (URL slug 'pet-accessories', N-2859243025) sitting alongside Bed & Bath, Kitchen & Tabletop, Pillows & Decor, etc. under the Home department nav - it is not further broken into sub-categories anywhere on the site. Confirmed via three independent sources on the fetched PLP HTML: (1) rendered H1 'Pet' + header '226 Items'; (2) the page's own embedded nav JSON entry for the exact node N-2859243025 reporting itemCount=226 (matches the rendered header exactly); (3) the full site navigationHierarchy JSON (burgerMenu-data block) shows this exact node has childCategories: [] (0 children), and the page's own category-filter facet dropdown lists Pet as a leaf sibling of Home's other top-level nodes with no nested submenu. The only other facets present on the page are color and price (no category/sub-category refinement), corroborating the flat structure. Sampled the first ~25 product titles on the listing (beds, toys, bowls, a pet gate, a cat scratcher, an automatic pet waterer, a pet food storage container, a pet costume) - all are pet accessories/gear, no pet food/treats or medical/veterinary items observed, so no consumable/medical flag applied. Also checked the 'New Arrivals > Pet' (itemCount=58) and 'Clearance > Pet' (itemCount=10) variants of this same node - both are cross-cutting merchandising filters over the same underlying Pet category (View All / featured), not distinct categories, so only the base 'Pet' node (226) is recorded per the grouping/overlap rule.
